title: メモリーズオフ 2nd
sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 593, utf16le 28 characters of prose-like text
Headless replay from a new game: 115 samples over 41 lines, and 24 choices (two or three answers)
Read in a reader during play on a handheld, before `when` was added: 20 lines and a choice matched the screen, and the opening movie filled every field with noise
Headless replay for the mode: 1 in every in-game sample, also with the menu, the message history and the save screen open; never 1 at boot, on the title screen or in the opening movie
notes: The script doesn't read on disc in a standard encoding; in memory it is Shift-JIS. Both discs boot the same executable. The layout with its `when` is not yet checked in a reader during play; later movies, the load and options screens and the second disc are unchecked.
